# Configuring the VoIP Applications Bandwidth Class

**Source:** https://help.zscaler.com/zia/configuring-voip-applications-bandwidth-class
**Captured:** 2026-10-18 via help_capture.py (article payload, canonical text)
**Revision:** node 1398951, revision 3243771

---

Watch a video about Bandwidth Classes, including about the VoIP Applications bandwidth class (shows legacy UI).
The VoIP Applications page allows you to enable or disable Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) applications. When configuring, it displays a list of VoIP applications that can be included in this class. To learn more, see About Bandwidth Classes.
To manage applications that belong to this class:
- From the navigation menu, go to Internet Access > Resources > Bandwidth Classes.
- Go to the VoIP Applications tab.
- Click Edit to enable or disable VoIP applications.
- See image
- The Edit drawer appears.
- In the Edit drawer, for the VoIP Applications section, enable or disable applications as necessary.
- See image.
- Click Save and activate the changes.
